text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is finally here. Hoping to make it a perfect finale, Fine Motion swears to put in a performance that will remain in the hearts of everyone who watches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess declares that, as Fine Motion's rival, she won't be holding anything back. Fine Motion herself has no intention of ceding victory either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just who will emerge victorious from this so-called "princess showdown"? The battle to find out begins now!
